integrity: Self-contained proof and bundled finite verification; mathematical novelty is not an assertion of priority over unindexed literature.
scientific_limitations: Nondegenerate socle pairing required; excludes other Loewy lengths, degenerate pairings and larger socles; fixed-r fixed-k field-size asymptotics; possible unindexed equivalent literature.
scope: Finite commutative local Gorenstein rings with nonzero one-dimensional radical square and radical cube zero, embedding dimension at least two.
title: Ideal-product universality and a two-to-three threshold in finite Loewy-three Gorenstein rings
